KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.3: It lures them out of camp and then crushes them in its maw. Bones break, bodies eaten.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.3: At least, I hope it's still in us. Somewhere.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.2: The sandstorm is deadlier than any dragon, young one. My son knew that and even though he took every precaution...
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.1: They say that I am descended from the Children of the Vault.
KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.1: Everyone knows someone who was lost to the Dearg Due.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.3: Yet, I can't kill this horrible hope in my heart. This poisonous feeling that he might return. Life is cruel, young one, best be ready for that.
KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.2: It likes the restless ones - the garou who talk about leaving and finding another camp.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.2: Take the Mark from us, and I think you would find a strong, humble people.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.1: Fionn? Oh... sorry, I thought...  well, how could you be? It's been years now, I don't know why he'd come back.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.1: Excuse us, adventurer. We are all in pain from Fuzan's Mark, which doesn't leave much room for courtesy and niceties.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.2: Several garou cubs emerged from the Vault to the south. They had no memory and were shorn of anything that you could identify them by.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.3: Nobody remembers what happened to them or how they found themselves in Manafem. But yeah, one of them was my great-great-great grandmother.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.1: The sandstorm ain't natural. There's whispering in the centre of them.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.2: Now, I ain't much of a weather person, but I know that sand can't whisper.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.3: It's the Dearg Due, I reckon. A bad spirit, spinning about in the wastes.
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.1: Nobody thinks about the little guys. I got tasks, you know. Things that need doin'.
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.2: But no-one going to help me, just 'cause I have no influence over the Elder.
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.3: I could make you a Mirror Lens outta some polished buttons.
